previousRequirement: Independently editable Bezier control points with durable, lossless native serialization.
Geometry-preserving exact curve subdivision and segment deletion/merging.
revisedRequirement: Use the supported native HWPX LINE/CURVE endpoint representation, preserve original segment identity/order/coordinates/metadata/ownership, and provide deterministic anchor editing.
Ordinary anchor insertion and deletion may intentionally change rendered curve geometry; this is a shape edit, not serialization loss.
Support LINE-to-CURVE and CURVE-to-LINE conversion for representable supported segments while preserving endpoints, connectivity, type-specific metadata safety, and durable serialization.

Exact subdivision and exact merging are conditional capabilities: enable only when the result is representable and independently proven geometry-equivalent; otherwise reject or omit the capability without mutation or history changes.

Independent Bezier control-point editing/serialization is not required when the supported HWPX representation has no verified native storage contract. Do not invent XML fields, treat derived controls as durable controls, or add sidecar storage.
Preserve unknown or incompatible segment metadata and fail closed when an edit cannot safely preserve it.
approvedContractRevision.revisionReason: The reviewed current KS X 6101 CurveType, Hancom model, pinned RHWP parser/writer, and available authentic samples expose endpoint-based hp:seg records without a verified independent Bezier-control serialization contract. Requiring universally exact operations on this representation would force an unsupported format assumption. The approved revision prioritizes native structure, editable anchors, explicit shape-changing operations, and conditional exact capabilities without weakening preservation guarantees.
operationPolicy: Anchor movement updates both records at a shared endpoint and retains closed-path closure.
Ordinary insertion duplicates the selected standard segment type and preserves path order/continuity; recomputed curve geometry may change intentionally.
Open-path endpoint deletion is unavailable; only interior anchors may be removed. Closed-path deletion retains closure. Both forms retain at least three unique anchors.

Deletion across a mixed LINE/CURVE boundary, or across unknown/extended segment metadata, is rejected atomically unless a safe merge rule is proven. Strict collinear LINE split/join remains its separate exact operation.
Segment type conversion changes only the type attribute on a connected childless standard envelope, retains endpoints and surrounding order, and rejects unknown or incompatible metadata.
Exact CURVE subdivision/merging and independent Bezier control-point mutation remain unavailable unless native serialization and geometric equivalence are proven.
approvedContractRevision.historicalEvidencePreservation: The prior strict requirement, earlier partial implementation status, format investigation, inferred Catmull-Rom limitations, and exact-subdivision counterexamples remain in this acceptance record. This revision does not claim that independent Bezier control-point serialization was implemented.

acceptanceCriteria.C01: Preserve native HWPX LINE/CURVE segment types, order, coordinates, required original attributes, connectivity, closure, ownership, and supported metadata.
acceptanceCriteria.C02: Verify ordinary anchor movement, insertion, and deletion with deterministic path updates and documented topology rules.
acceptanceCriteria.C03: Verify supported LINE-to-CURVE and CURVE-to-LINE conversion while preserving endpoints, surrounding connectivity, ownership, formatting, and durable segment type.
acceptanceCriteria.C04: Verify valid open and closed path behavior, shared endpoint connectivity, closure, and minimum geometry constraints.
acceptanceCriteria.C05: Distinguish ordinary shape-changing anchor operations from conditional geometry-preserving exact subdivision and exact merging.
acceptanceCriteria.C06: Reject unsupported independent Bezier edits and nonrepresentable exact operations without document mutation, misleading capability exposure, or history changes.
acceptanceCriteria.C07: Preserve unrelated XML/OPC parts, object ownership, formatting, transformations, supported metadata, and resource relationships.
acceptanceCriteria.C08: Verify Undo/Redo and narrowly scoped T009 semantic preservation for every supported mutation.
acceptanceCriteria.C09: Inspect the actual saved HWPX structure and independently reopen it with intended segment types, coordinates, and edited geometry intact.
acceptanceCriteria.C10: Run actual Linux X11 guarded Release Native acceptance for the revised supported behavior and capability restrictions.

implementedSubset: Parse, retain, and edit supported native HWPX LINE/CURVE anchors while preserving segment type, order, coordinates, shared endpoints, closure, supported source metadata, ownership, and unrelated package content.

Move a selected supported anchor; update both connected segment endpoints and preserve closed-path topology. Reject stale identity, invalid coordinates, unknown segment semantics, or ambiguous metadata atomically.
Perform ordinary supported anchor insertion and deletion deterministically. For CURVE paths these operations may intentionally change rendered shape; they are not exact subdivision/merge.

Convert supported representable segments LINE-to-CURVE and CURVE-to-LINE while retaining endpoints and connectivity and preserving only metadata valid for the target segment type; reject incompatible unknown metadata.

Perform exact LINE split/join only for strict representable cases: childless standard LINE envelope with exact known fields and an interior integer point on the line; join only eligible adjacent collinear LINE segments. Preserve source order, path closure, and unrelated OPC parts.

Compute the supported sample-inferred Catmull–Rom-derived geometry for rendering and hit testing. This is not a KS X 6101 guarantee and derived Bezier controls are not independently editable or serialized.

Keep exact CURVE subdivision/merge and independent Bezier control-point editing/serialization unavailable unless a verified native representation and geometric equivalence are established; fail closed without mutation.

currentOfficialStandard.schemaFinding: Annex E CurveType contains an unbounded sequence of seg. Each seg has exactly type (default CURVE; enum LINE/CURVE), x1, y1, x2, y2 integer attributes, with no child elements or xs:any wildcard. ConnectLineType separately defines controlPoints/point; that is not a CurveType contract.
currentOfficialStandard.conclusion: The supported current schema does not provide an editable Bezier control-point serialization contract. Keep those mutations fail-closed unless a compatible authentic extension/sample establishes one.

rhwpModelReview.finding: The parser builds a point chain from each hp:seg start/end pair and leaves the HWP5-specific segment_types field empty for HWPX. The writer emits endpoint hp:seg records from that chain. The added ordered patch records whether each source hp:seg had children and exposes structural split/join only for childless LINE records with exactly the five standard attributes. The geul edit path retains segment metadata/order and original segment types outside the touched LINE records; unsupported source envelopes are rejected.

officialRevalidation.scope: Annex E ParaList XML Schema: CurveType and ConnectLineType.
officialRevalidation.finding: CurveType has an unbounded seg sequence. Each seg has exactly type (default CURVE; LINE/CURVE enum), x1, y1, x2, y2 integer attributes; no child elements or xs:any wildcard. ConnectLineType separately defines controlPoints/point, which is not a CurveType control-point contract.
officialRevalidation.methodLimit: This revalidation checks the current official schema, pinned RHWP parser/model/writer, and tracked sample corpus. The corpus is observational and cannot establish absence of proprietary extensions.

revalidationMethod.rhwpReview: At RHWP pin 1a76570e833917d15817415a53c09ad61ab3203f, the HWPX parser reduces each seg to endpoint point-chain entries; HWP5-specific segment_types remains empty for HWPX; the writer emits hp:seg endpoint pairs.

files.finding: CCurveType stores repeated CSeg child objects along with the common shape model.
CSeg declares only type, x1, y1, x2 and y2 data members; it declares no independent Bezier control coordinates.
ReadAttribute and WriteElement read/write exactly type, x1, y1, x2 and y2.
CCurveType maps repeated seg elements to CSeg and serializes that model; no separate Bezier-control child is mapped.
The control-points accessor belongs to CConnectLineType, a distinct connector model.
The controlPoints element is mapped as CConnectControlPoints under CConnectLineType, not CCurveType.

officialHancomModel.scope: This Hancom-published model implementation corroborates the current revision 03 schema for the inspected contract. It is not itself the normative standard and does not rule out private extensions or authentic samples that are not public.

evidenceLevels.documented: The active KS X 6101:2024 revision 03 CurveType and the inspected Hancom CCurveType/CSeg model expose segment type and endpoints only; the pinned RHWP HWPX writer emits endpoint segments.
evidenceLevels.empirical: The tracked sample corpus audit found 337 curve objects and 1504 segments across readable candidates, with only type/x1/y1/x2/y2 and no segment child elements. This is observational evidence, not proof that all compatible files lack extensions.
evidenceLevels.inference: Within the inspected standard/model/writer envelope, there is no proven durable place for independently editable Bezier controls. This conclusion is bounded to reviewed public evidence and is not a universal claim that no proprietary representation exists.

paths.finding: No independent Bezier-control field or child is present in the active CurveType schema, Hancom CSeg model/serializer, or pinned RHWP HWPX parser/writer.
paths.result: No verified direct native serialization contract; keep independent-control mutations fail-closed.

paths.finding: ConnectLineType.controlPoints belongs to connector-specific start/end/control-point semantics, not a free CurveType path. Replacing the curve with raster, polyline, or another shape changes editability, geometry, or object semantics; no alternative standard representation preserving the original editable-curve contract was verified.

De Casteljau subdivision can exactly split a cubic when its four Bezier points are available. The endpoint-only CSeg representation cannot durably store independent inner controls. Existing Catmull–Rom-derived handles are functions of neighboring anchors, so arbitrary independent handle edits cannot be serialized through that model with a proven exact geometry mapping. Exact inverse-subdivision deletion likewise requires known child control geometry and representable parent geometry; approximate fitting is not exact.
paths.result: The algorithm is mathematically valid under its control-point precondition, but that precondition and resulting geometry are not durably representable by the verified CurveType contract. No CURVE split/delete or approximate fitting was implemented.

paths.finding: A geul-only extension or sidecar could not be shown to preserve rendering and editability when an external HWPX editor ignores or removes it; no such extension was introduced.
paths.result: Not accepted as interoperable completion without a standard contract and authentic cross-editor roundtrip evidence.

catmullRomSplitCounterexample.modelScope: 기존 공개 sample에서 추론한 uniform Catmull–Rom-to-cubic 규칙에 한정된 정확한 대수 반례다. 이 예는 인접 anchor를 유지하며, KS X 6101 또는 Hancom curve semantics의 보편적 증명이 아니다.
catmullRomSplitCounterexample.conclusion: 두 child cubic의 재인코딩 controls가 de Casteljau 결과와 각각 다르므로, 이 정확한 split 전략은 인접 anchor를 보존한 채 같은 uniform Catmull–Rom 규칙으로 lossless하게 표현되지 않는다. 이는 이 추론 모델의 counterexample이며 다른 HWPX/Hancom curve semantics를 일반화하지 않는다. approximate fit은 구현하지 않았다.

connectorCandidateInvestigation.documented: 현행 e나라 KS X 6101:2024 rev03 CurveType의 childless seg는 type/x1/y1/x2/y2만 정의한다. Hancom 공개 모델 commit 1453388472c703a4b299a0834f425cdac16644b9에서 CSeg parser/writer도 이 다섯 필드만 다루며, CConnectLineType은 별도의 startPt/endPt/controlPoints 모델이다. 공식 도움말(https://help.hancom.com/hoffice110/en-US/HShow/drawing/edit_points_line.htm)은 일반 선의 Edit Points 기능과 곡선 segment 전환/삭제를 설명하지만 HWPX curve serialization contract를 정하지 않는다. 다른 공식 도움말(https://help.hancom.com/hoffice100/en-US/Hwp/draw/drawing%28polygon%29.htm)은 Curve와 Object Connector를 별도 도형으로 설명하고 connector가 다른 도형에 붙어 대상 이동 시 따라간다고 설명한다.
connectorCandidateInvestigation.empirical: external/rhwp/samples/**/*.hwpx에서 connector 20개를 확인했다: 18 STRAIGHT_ONEWAY(point type 3,26), 2 STROKE_ONEWAY(point type 3,2,2,26), ARC는 0개다. Authentic public SimpleCurve fixture에서 현재 추론한 Catmull–Rom handles에는 소수 좌표가 있고 connector point x/y는 정수다; 따라서 이 추론 geometry를 connector로 정확히 변환할 수 없다.
connectorCandidateInvestigation.inferenceAndLimitations: SimpleCurve의 Catmull–Rom handle 모델은 sample geometry에서 도출한 inference이며 KS가 보장하는 semantics가 아니다. Connector는 연결 대상과 이동 결합을 갖는 별도 object semantics/type change다. detached ARC_NOARROW의 Hancom save/reopen 호환성에 대한 증거도 없다. 따라서 connector는 독립 Bezier controls를 저장하는 대체 CurveType으로 인정하지 않으며, 기존 partial 편집 동작을 유지한다. 이는 검토한 표준·공개 모델·samples의 범위에 한정되며 미공개 proprietary extension의 부재를 보편적으로 증명하지 않는다.

contractV1Acceptance.scope: P4-HX-CURVE only; all previously accepted 38 issue IDs remain accepted. The original strict independent-control-point requirement remains historically unfulfilled and is not represented as implemented.

operations.nativeSegments: Preserve supported LINE/CURVE type, ordering, coordinates, shared endpoint connectivity, closure, source envelope metadata and object ownership.
operations.anchorMovement: Move connected native anchors, update both segment endpoints where shared, and preserve closed-path topology.
operations.ordinaryInsertionDeletion: Insert/delete supported anchors deterministically. Curve geometry may intentionally change; this is a shape edit, not serialization loss. Unsupported endpoints, invalid topology, mixed-type boundaries, unknown metadata, or ambiguous ownership fail closed.
operations.segmentTypeConversion: Support LINE-to-CURVE and CURVE-to-LINE conversion on representable supported segments while retaining endpoints, order, connectivity and safe metadata.
operations.exactLineOperations: Exact LINE split/join are separately supported only for strict representable childless standard LINE records and proven collinear integer geometry.
operations.exactCurveOperations: Exact CURVE split/merge are disabled unless future native representability and geometric equivalence are independently proven.
operations.derivedGeometry: Catmull-Rom-derived cubic handles are inferred from an authentic sample anchor/preview model; this interpolation is not guaranteed by KS X 6101 and handles are not independent persisted controls.
